description: This file implements URL handling functionalities including parsing, encoding, decoding, and Base64 operations within the WPEFramework namespace. It defines URL parsing logic, URL encoding/decoding, and base64 encoding/decoding functions.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class for parsing, representing, and reconstructing URLs, with support for URL components such as scheme, host, port, path, query, username, and password.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-safe format.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting hostname and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Reconstructs the URL from its components into a string representation.

uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
